```{r setup-mascot_gesture, include = FALSE, echo = FALSE}
studio_character <- if (exists("studio_character")) studio_character else formals(mascot::mascot)$character
# Animations that play only at rest but appear in the gesture listing (#375), as the studio lists them.
resting_names <- if (exists("studio_resting_gestures")) studio_resting_gestures else stats::setNames("shimmer", formals(mascot::mascot)$character)
```

```{r mascot_gesture-try-live, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_try_live("mascot_gesture")
```

### Gestures

```{r mascot_gesture-cards, echo = FALSE}
guide_each_character(function(ch) {
  gestures <- mascot::mascot_gestures(ch)
  resting_name <- resting_names[ch]
  resting <- gestures$name %in% resting_name
  htmltools::tagList(
    if (any(resting)) {
      htmltools::tags$p(paste(resting_name, "is", paste0(mascot::mascot_character(ch)$name, "'s"), "idle animation."))
    },
    if (in_studio() && any(resting)) {
      htmltools::tags$p("Choose its resting animation entry in the sentence to try it.")
    },
    guide_gesture_cards(gestures[!resting, ])
  )
})
```

```{r mascot_gesture-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("mascot_gesture", studio_character)
```
